beats.headline: Dibs on the hat
beats.text: Combat starts in a voice Carl has never heard before, and the Experience lopes at them: a wolf-sized thing on stiff legs with a comically large human head, an angry bearded guy in a glowing red beret, suspiciously like Che Guevara, barking like a man through a megaphone. Donut's missiles and fireball do most of the work. If he joins the squad, she says, he will have to shave, and she gets to keep his hat. Too late: he dies. Dibs on the hat. Looting him, she gasps at the beret's stats, puts it on, and wonders about embracing the revolutionary look.

beats.headline: Appropriate for the location
beats.text: Donut usually wears her white Tiara of Mana Genita, which raises her intelligence. She also has the red beret she took from a mob earlier on the floor. It gives only a small boost to all of her stats, but she puts it on from time to time because it is appropriate for the location. She keeps literally hundreds of hats in her inventory, and sometimes lines several up in front of the mirror, or tries one on Mongo, who sits patiently while she clucks over it.
